user.description: Set up Pinned Push. Afterwards, add one entry per notification you want to send.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Pinned Push is already set up. Add notifications to the existing entry.

user.title: Add notification
user.description: The notification is pinned on the phones of the selected people and comes back when swiped away, until someone presses a button.

data_description.name: Also names the device and its entities, for example event.early_shift.
data_description.persons: The phones are taken from each person's tracked devices.
data_description.devices: Companion App devices that should receive it in addition.
data_description.title: Can be overridden when sending.
data_description.buttons: Up to two more buttons. Android shows three buttons at most.
data_description.expire_minutes: Removed from all phones after this time. 0 means never.

data_description.buttons: Renaming a button changes its event type. Update automations that trigger on the old name.
data_description.expire_minutes: Removed from all phones after this time. 0 means never.

error.no_recipients: Select at least one person or phone.
error.too_many_buttons: Android shows three buttons at most: the confirm button plus two more.
error.duplicate_buttons: Every button needs a different label.
error.reserved_button: "expired" is reserved for notifications that time out.

no_recipients.message: No phone found for {notification}. Check the people and phones of this notification.

unknown_notification.message: {entity_id} is not a Pinned Push notification.

missing_recipients.title: Pinned Push: phone not found for {notification}
missing_recipients.description:
No Companion App could be found for: {recipients}.

For a person, select their phone under Settings → People → tracked devices, or log in to the Companion App with that person's user. For a phone, check that it is still registered in the Mobile App integration.

This message disappears with the next successful send.

send.name: Send
send.description: Sends a pinned notification, or replaces it if it is already showing.

title.name: Title
title.description: Replaces the configured title for this send.

message.name: Message
message.description: Replaces the configured message for this send.

persons.name: People
persons.description: Replaces the configured people and phones for this send.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Removes an open notification from all phones without an answer.
